findings.finding: Task start lacks overlapping-file ownership enforcement; src/core and src/core/fsm.ts are simultaneously assigned.
findings.required: Non-overlapping explicit ownership and a runtime overlap guard before start.

findings.finding: Task verify trusts dependency verified status without verifying current dependency source/AC evidence.
findings.required: Revalidate dependency source-bound latest receipts before accepting dependent verification.

findings.finding: Receipt artifacts validation does not require the registered artifact key set; empty artifacts vacuously pass.
findings.required: Require exact registered artifact inventory and hashes, with adversarial selftest.

findings.finding: Balance candidate registers metric names but no acceptance bounds or candidate-selection criterion.
findings.required: Register policy-specific quantitative target intervals and rare-item nonarrival reporting before held-out candidate validation.
